👋 "#DiGregorio understood that #Juventus wants to completely change in goal, the club also wants a be second-choice keeper and therefore he will leave. He has been offered to #Marseille, while #Monza does not appear to me to be an option at the moment. The parties are ready to say goodbye before the end of the mercato: the management and the entourage have spoken in these hours and the way out has been indicated."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

As reported on @cmdotcom and on my YouTube channel, #Fofana and #Tomori are not facilitating their exit from #Milan. From the rossonero club, the message is clear and direct: either they find a solution before the end of the calciomercato or they will be left out of the squad list.[Daniele Longo]

🔚👋 "Pastorello is working in these hours and has had a new conversation with #Juventus: for #Arthur, they are moving torward termination. In the pre-season, he was tested by #Spalletti, but it is clear that there is no space for him. The relations between the agent, the player and the club are excellent and are based on mutual respect. This option would allow freeing up space for another addition."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤🧐 "#Perin has decided to listen to #Palermo's offer: he has not closed the door and is seriously considering the proposal. On one side is #Juventus, with only one year left in the contract, while on the other is the rosanero club, with a multi-year project and the possibility to be at the center of the project. A track to follow with close attention, keeping an eye on #MilinkovicSavic as well."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🤔 "On #DiGregorio, at the moment, the scenario has not changed: he should leave, with several opportunities especially abroad. At the same time, however, he has always given signals of wanting to stay, even after the controversy related to his agent's statements. He would even be willing to serve as deputy and play his cards, an option not to be excluded."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇧🇷🔚 "From what I understand, it was #Arthur along with his agents who proposed to #Juventus in the last few hours the possibility of terminating his contract. He would like to do it shortly, before the end of the mercato, so he can find another club. Negotiations and evaluations are underway to reach an economic agreement."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
#Juventus, tomorrow the possible termination of #Arthur's contract.@sportmediaset[Orazio Accomando]

Expected direct talks in the next Hours between #Juventus and #Arthur Melo’s agent to try to terminate the contract by mutual agreement. The two parties are now discussing the details of the deal and the severance-pay. #transfers[Nico Schira]

Excl. - Talks in progress for Michele #DiGregorio to #OlympiqueMarseille from #Juventus on loan until June 2027. Tonight the goalkeeper has reached an agreement in principle with #OM, which have just asked to #Juve a support on the salary’s payment. #transfers #TeamOM[Nico Schira]

🇨🇴👋 "The next player who should leave is #Cabal. #Bologna, after having sold #Lucumí, is evaluating several defenders, including one abroad, and is deciding whether to focus on the Colombian or not. #Juventus must get rid of his card, with the contract expiring in 2027, or evaluate a formula of a loan with an option to buy."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤⁉️ "#Perin could be a surprise: his contract is expiring, #Palermo is looking for a goalkeeper and they want to win the league. #Inzaghi has also given his approval. The negotiation has started, but they need to find the right fits. The hierarchy placed the ex #Genoa ahead of #DiGregorio: if the player born in 1992 leaves, the ex #Monza could stay to be the second choice, even though foreign tracks could open up for him."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🎯🧐 "#Koopmeiners is waiting, something is starting to move in England. To balance the deal carried out, #Juventus would need a sale of €30M, but they can settle for €25M. This is an essential step, along with finding a suitor for #Miretti and understanding whether #Kessié will make the Saudi choice or wait a bit longer. I expect something in midfield, perhaps a regista, a sector that lacks quality."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
